name: Seito-tachi ni Sarashimono ni Sareta Onna Kyoushi Tachibana Hitomi Byouin Hen 4
original_name: 生徒たちに晒し者にされた女教師立花仁美病院編4
source:
Tachibana-sensei was the teacher of privileged students at a rich private academy,
who was caught on video doing naughty things, and used as a sex slave.

She is forced to do/wear unbelievably embarrassing things by 
men who are much younger than herself.
